page.overview:
Who is Phin O'Garee?

Phin O'Garee was born into a tomb robbing family on Hagal. As a child, he met Tidjii. Phin's father, who had not conducted the necessary research beforehard, led them in an attempted robbery of a tomb that belonged to a formidable family. Now being hunted, Phin and Tidjii travelled to the furthest planet they could afford to travel to, Arrakis. They later married and had five children; Phin Jr., Phaedra, Brie, Sally and Koda.

Tidjii was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in Arrakeen. He declared that if they needed something, O'Garee's Imports had it, and would get it if they did not.
